chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abi al-Mi'za, from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever does not visit the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) until he dies, he is deficient in religion and deficient in faith, and even if he enters Paradise, he will be below the believers in Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of neglecting the visitation of Imam Husayn's grave?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to establish Ziyarat al-Husayn as a pivotal act of devotion, linking physical visitation to spiritual completeness. The hadith distinguishes between the certainty of Paradise and the relative rank of the believer, suggesting that neglecting this specific connection to the Ahl al-Bayt results in a qualitative diminishment of one's faith (Iman) and religious practice (Deen).

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn Walīd narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ’Ali ibn Ḥakam, from Abil Maghrā, from ‘Anbasah ibn Mus’ab, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

Those who do not go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) before their death are lacking in faith and their belief is incomplete. And even if they enter Paradise, their position will be lower than that of the believers.
